messages:
Maria N.: Quick sync on action items from the INC-451 postmortem — pulled current list below. Please confirm ownership and realistic ETAs (or reassign). I’ll update the incident ticket after confirmations. Thanks!

- Action 1: Add model-variant fallback routing + automated fallback metrics. Owner: @Ben O.  Due: 2026-03-26  
- Action 2: Add KV-cache miss/rate metric to alerting + runbook link. Owner: @Alex K.  Due: 2026-03-22
- Action 3: Docs: canary rollback procedure + example policy snippet. Owner: @Samir  Due: 2026-03-24
- Action 4: Draft customer notification for impacted accounts (legal sign-off needed). Owner: @Jenn R.  Due: 2026-03-23
- Action 5: Load run for Dedicated GPU pool autoscale validation (100k rps sim). Owner: @Chris L.  Due: 2026-03-30
- Action 6: Security review: private deployment KMS/HSM key rotation flow. Owner: Security (TBD)  Due: 2026-04-02

Ben O.: I can take Action 1 but there's a dependency on the runtime routing change in eng-runtime (PR #800). Would like to push the due date to 2026-03-28 to cover testing. I'll post the PR link shortly. :+1:

Alex K.: Confirming Action 2. Quick question — do we want the alert to fire on absolute KV miss rate > 2% or relative increase > 50%? I'll draft a change in the alerts config and put up a tiny PR by EOD.

Samir: Taking Action 3. I have the docs skeleton in a branch: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/312. Need a sample canary config from oncall to include the thresholds. @Chris L. can you share the canary window you used during the incident?

Jenn R.: I can draft the customer note for Action 4 and loop in Legal + Comms. Will need product review for tone. Can we target 3/23 as a soft deadline — if Legal needs more time we'll escalate. Tagging @Maria N. for priority.

Chris L.: For Action 5 I need a 4-hour GPU reservation slot. Prefer to run the load test on 2026-03-27 morning (UTC). If that's okay I'll book the reserved pool and post the test plan (load profile + seed data). Samir — I can attach the canary window we used.

Aisha S. (Sec): Security will own Action 6. Assign to me and the sec-eng queue. Quick scope request: do we need a full red-team pass or just KMS rotation/permission audit? Suggest pushing date to 2026-04-05 unless the team wants an earlier quick-scan.

Ben O.: PR link for runtime change: github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/800. Leaving a comment for QA on the fallback tests. Also :thumbsup: on updated due date 3/28.

Alex K.: Updated alert draft posted: github.com/redwood/monitoring/pull/455 — please review; config path is `monitoring/alerts/kv_cache.yaml`. I'll include runbook steps in that PR.

Samir: Got the canary snippet from Chris — added to docs branch. Will request review from @Alex K. and @Maria N. today.

Jenn R.: I added a placeholder customer note to `inc-451/docs/customer-notice.md` and sent to Legal. Will post a link when Legal replies.

IncidentBot: INC-451 updated — 6 actions added to postmortem.

DeployBot: Reminder: please add PR prefixes `INC-451` to related PRs for easier tracking.

Maria N.: Thanks all. Action items now:
- Ben: Action 1 -> due 2026-03-28 (confirmed)
- Alex: Action 2 -> draft by EOD, final 2026-03-22
- Samir: Action 3 -> docs PR ready for review 2026-03-24
- Jenn: Action 4 -> customer draft 2026-03-23 (Legal pending)
- Chris: Action 5 -> load test plan + reservation (target 2026-03-27)
- Aisha/Sec: Action 6 -> reassigned to sec-eng, suggested due 2026-04-05

If anyone needs to reassign or can't meet the date, reply here and we'll update INC-451 accordingly. I’ll update the ticket with these confirmations in ~1 hour.

Ben O.: Sounds good to me.

Alex K.: On it.

Samir: Will ping if blocker.

Jenn R.: Will chase Legal and update here.

Chris L.: Reserving 2026-03-27 morning now.

Aisha S. (Sec): Assigned in sec queue. Will confirm by 2026-03-20.
